verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a tax agency, so the axis applies. The pack has nothing on published processing times for any transaction type. The 'Webfile reports in processing' notice and the 'Look Up Account Status' tool cover report or account status, not service-published turnaround times, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
